freeze_rule: This protocol and its return W are fixed before either learner is started.
operational_agent: A classical mathematical-agent proxy with isolated training, learned operation selection, exhaustive execution, frozen state, and an independent construction/check of the precommitted translational operations.

mathematical_foundation.reference_frame: A carrier together with the equality admitted by its axiom geometry.
mathematical_foundation.geom_equiv: A reversible occurrence translation that preserves and reflects the admitted equality.
mathematical_foundation.resolved_in: A total question is constant on the frame equality classes and therefore factors through the quotient.
mathematical_foundation.open_in: A relation between one named frame and one total question, witnessed by frame-equal occurrences the question separates.

translational_closure.occurrence_form: Y_l = Pole x B_l after each local basis has been learned and frozen.
translational_closure.return_W: W_l(p,b)=b; the reference frame is defined first by W_l(x)=W_l(y).
translational_closure.basis_translation_phi: Every candidate frame form carries learned identities by a bijective operation-preserving map phi.
translational_closure.orientation_pi: pi is the relative preservation or reversal disclosed by the candidate comparison.
translational_closure.reversal_J: J(p,b)=(other(p),b) and must be natural through T.
translational_closure.curvature_C: C selects a pole section transported through pi and must be natural through T.
translational_closure.quotient_basis: Y_l modulo W-relative equality must be equivalent to B_l.
translational_closure.universal_factorization: Every closure-respecting Bool evaluation must factor uniquely through W_l.
translational_closure.selection_boundary: The translator sees frozen local operations and only the listed contacts. The verifier constructs the reference frames, checks GeomEquiv preservation and reflection, and only then checks naturality and question factorization.

relational_contact.relation: A precommitted contact selects one orientation-preserving axiom-geometry equivalence.

relative_reversal.relation: A reversed contact selects another valid GeomEquiv with nontrivial pi; it must not be rejected against fixed coordinates.

structural_family.relation: All eight coherent GeomEquiv comparisons are retained; no independent contact selects one. This non-selection is not misclassified as OpenIn.

non_natural_deformation.relation: A sign-erasing total map fails invertibility and operation naturality and supplies an explicit outside-closure witness.

self_certification_only.relation: A self-claim selects no GeomEquiv and provides no independent contact.

token_policy.admission_predicate: Issue only for the actual branch when independent contact selects a GeomEquiv and the subsequent W,E,T,phi,pi,J,C relations commute.
